nom: PEACH & LILY Rice Dough Smoothing Facial Scrub

avis.texte: As someone with sensitive, "mature" skin this is the greatest scrub ever. I have never been able to use any scrub I've ever tried because of irritation. I tried this one because I like their other products I have tried and for the nourishment. It applies thick, then wet your hands and massage the skin. It has a nice, faint smell and does not irritate. It makes your skin feel wonderful.
I exfoliate every day and often find problems with over drying and stripping oils from my skin. This product exfoliates very well and leaves it soft and Dewey.
This is my second order. Really exfoliates and makes my skin look soft and glowing.
This had a mochi like texture and though it takes a good sized dollop to spread, it softens your complexion.
Okay this smells amazing. I wish they would use ginger in all their products. I love how easy it is to exfoliate with this product. My skin feels soft smooth after using.

I love this gentle exfoliating scrub. The label says no fragrance but I think it has a lovely light floral fragrance, similar to something an esthetician would use during a facial. Only takes a small amount so even though this was a bit spendy, I can see it lasting for months.

This rice facial scrub really makes a difference. It makes me skin super soft immediately after the first use. I use it a couple times a week after doing my double cleanser. Little goes a long way and on dry skin works the best. Smell reminds me of ginger from sushi which I love but might night be everyones favorite.

My skin is so sensitive that I have never been able to use a "scrub" but this crazy stuff is wonderful. Just enough to exfoliate without irritation. Apply dry and then wet your hands to thin it out a little. Great stuff. Skin feels so smooth.

avis.titre: Great for smooth texture, minus harshness
avis.texte: This face wash is great for smoothing skin texture. Clean ingredients give it a nice consistency that is not harsh to skin. Very helpful for a smooth look.

I love this!! I prefer using this over my other exfoliators. It glides on so well and a little goes a long way! I can use it every day with no issues. I can already see an improvement in my skin texture.

avis.titre: Tossed after product appeared to grow mold
avis.texte: Today, I saw that Peach responded to someone's question and said there's an explanation for what looks like mold growth in the jar, but I threw mine out months ago. They said it can't be fungus, but that's absolutely what it looked like to me. They said it may develop "some" white spots (or something similar), but mine looked like a solid layer of mold. I'm sad I wasted my money on this.
This is the best exfoliator I've used in years. My skin is so soft after using it and it's helping to even out my rough bumps. I've even gotten my boyfriend to use it and he loves it too!

avis.titre: The Most Fun I've Ever Had With A Scrub
avis.texte: As a skincare junkie, I've tried just about every kind of product out there. It is rare for me to come across something totally new, but the texture of the Rice Dough Smoothing Facial Scrub is an absolute sensory delight! It literally feels like a cross between a light dough and a gel, with little bits of rice and fibers in it that add a smoothing, buffing feel without any scratchiness. When you wash it off, your skin feels dewy and moisturized but not tight. I never want to be without this scrub!

I really love this product. You can feel it working. I dont mind the grit. My face is smooth and you can tell dead skin cells are gone. I was taught to stay with one company because all tge products work together, so I only use Peace and Lilly.

This is the perfect gentle exfoliator. It is soft enough it does not cause irritation but rough enough to actually see a change in skin texture. I used it for two days and saw results really quickly. It is definitely going to be a staple in my routine
Works well and is gentle on my skin but still helps exfoliate and also helps smooth my skin.

avis.titre: I expected more for the price I paid
avis.texte: I shouldve returned it but i wanted to give it a try because of the reviews. The smell was unpleasant. I liked the grains but struggled when washing it off tbere was so much and wouks get stuck on my eyelashes. It did not help reduce my pores whatsoever.

I was reluctant to buy this because there are so many cheaper exfoliators on the market, but I decided to try it when it was on sale. I would pay full price for this now that I've used it. My face feels so smooth and soft. I kept checking the mirror because I couldnt get over how nicely my makeup went on.
I use it every 2 or 3 days and removes dead skin and helps all products better soak into skin

I love the Rice Dough Smoothing Facial Scrub! I use most of the Peach & Lily cleansers along with the Glass Skin Face Polisher, and was glad when the facial scrub was added to the line. My AM & PM routines are different but also different from day to day, sometimes it just depends on how I feel! I love the entire Peach & Lily line!

avis.titre: Perfection! Exactly what I was looking for.
avis.texte: The pliable product works well, & moves over my skin to easily exfoliate, even where I need it most. My skin feels much softer, more nourished each time. Especially during the brutal dry, winter months. A small amount goes a long way, and used consistently & correctly 3+ times a week has made a wonderful difference for me.

I wanted to like this scrub, but it wasn't what I expected. The scent is unusual and not very pleasant, and the texture surprised me—I expected something more granular, but any grit is very minimal. I tried it on both dry and wet skin: on dry skin it felt more like a mild peel, while on wet skin it had more of an emollient, creamy feel. It does smooth the skin, but if you're looking for a traditional scrub with noticeable exfoliating particles, this may not be it.

This is not a nuclear option for exfoliation but I would say it delivers what it claims to do. I have pustular rosacea, eczema prone skin. I needed something to help with some build up but couldn't apply a chemical exfoliant after treatments and I had some angry pustules so I was expecting some irriation. Was pleasantly surpised my skin was calm the morning after. Will continue to try this on an as needed basis!

This oroduct doesn't exfoliate in any way. Not in a physical or chemical sense. The texture is strange, the smell omisbthat of strong spouled milk and ny skin that never reacts yo anything….broke out and my eyes swelled nearly shut. This product deserves zero stars
This product has a wonderful doughy texture. It's gentle and does a great job exfoliating, without aggravating my sensitive skin - would buy again!

I was a bit hesitant to try this out since it does contain some essential oils, which I typically avoid due to my sensitive skin. However, I add water to the scrub to make it even more gentle and I haven't had an issue. It makes my skin so soft and smooth! I love the doughy texture and even the smell, even though I typically look for fragrance-free products. Since I only use it 1-2x a week, one jar has lasted me a really long time!
Balances my pigmentation leaving my face without spots and discoloration!

This is so light to use every night and has a dainty scent to make it that much better! Makes your facial skin so smooth and shiny!I absolutely love this and all of the other Peach and Lily products! :-)

avis.titre: Use it on DRY SKIN not wet
avis.texte: This scrub is gentle and rough at the same time. Just make sure not to wet your face or fingers before using it. And I promise you will get a polished feel to your skin.

I wasn't sure what to think about this product at first - but three jars in, I really like it and use it 2-3x weekly. I need to exfoliate regularly and this is really gentle but effective. The smell is not a plus, but my skin feels immediately softer and smoother after each use. I wish it came in a larger jar.

avis.titre: Did nothing, complete waste of money
avis.texte: "Scrub" suggests some sort of particle physically exfoliating your skin, right? Even if it's a "micro-exfoliant". This concoction contains no scrubby particles at all, just a dirty beige goop that didn't even raise some color in my cheeks when I rubbed it across my face. I left it on, tried several times hoping it would have some enzymatic effect. Nothing. I finally threw it away. Another waste of money on Peach & Lily products.

I saw so many good reviews online and yall lied! I tried this once before returning. The texture is odd to say the least. It feels like gel to the touch but then left a film on my skin after rinsing. The smell starts out lightly pleasant then quickly turns to spoiled milk. The best part was the following day when my face/neck had an epic breakout of small red bumps all over.. There are too many other good options out there to suffer with this price or result.
I love this. Leaves my skin so soft and smooth. I recommend this for everyone.

I'm very sensitive to many things, so every time I try something new, it's hard to predict how my skin will react. But what a relief — this face scrub is safe for me! I'm so happy to have discovered this brand.
Smells good, feels good. Doesn't feel very exfoliating. Kind of feels gimmicky.

I was undecided about what to expect from the scrub. I love all P&L products so I expected it to be good, but hadn't used a scrub like this before. I am glad I tried it because it's so gentle yet effective. The texture is unique, kind of a bouncy, textured gel at first but works nicely with exfoliating my normal to dry skin. I use it weekly and see a nice glow!
I bought this product for the 1st time today and I am so flipping happy about it. It makes my skin so soft and its not too abrasive either!!

i usually stick to liquid exfoliants but i wanted to try a physical one for fun. what a bad idea- this made my skin so rough and bumpy and red!!! it has ruined my usually smooth and clear skin! it now feels like snake skin :( came to see if others had this problem and some did, beware

avis.titre: very nice gentle exfoliation and makes my skin so soft!
avis.texte: absolutely love this product! super gentle exfoliation for my sensitive skin. i love the smell of the product its super overbearing and after i use it my skin is so so soft! i feel it helps smooth out the microbumps on my skin
This has helped my skin so much, it's smoother, let's blotchy and has a beautiful glow. I am happy to have been turned onto Peach & Lily products as a whole.

This stuff is luxurious! It has just enough of a scrub feel and if you need less just add water for a gentler experience. Either way this is a gentle and skin softening scrub. My skin has never felt so smooth!
gentle exfoliation. i use it about every 3 days and it really makes the skin smooth. i feel a big difference when i moisturize after.
I used 2/3 of the jar, but didn't notice any improvement to my skin texture or pores. I would not purchase this product again as I've obtained better results from less expensive products.

avis.titre: Squeaky clean but under my nails
avis.texte: I like that this product foams a little and the texture is really unusual (in a good way!) Would prefer not to have to scoop it out of the jar though - a tube would be better but understand that this might not work
This leaves my skin feeling so soft. It's also gentle on my very sensitive skin.
This is my first time ever have a reaction from a face product. I used this scrub lastnight and I woke up this morning with my face itching, swollen eyes and red blotches on my cheeks!
I love this product. Not too harsh on sensitive skin my face glows after using. Highly recommend
Amazing! Very effective, but very gentle. I use every other day. Will definitely be permanent part of skin routine!

This rice dough face scrub leaves my face feeling so soft. In addition to that I also use the rice water toner, so my face is just extra soft and bright. I just wish it was a little more firm, however it gets the job done

This scrub smelled really nice and has a gentle feel, but for the price it didn't spread very well and didn't seem to really do anything? It didn't feel exfoliating like you'd expect from a scrub and after using it for a couple weeks I didn't notice any difference in my skin to contradict that meh feeling. It feels more like it wants to be a masks but has no actual benefits.
This is one of the best scrubs i've ever tried. Very gentle but smoothing - my skin feels amazingly soft & clean. Love it!
This scrub does not seem to irritate my extremely sensitive skin . I use it sparingly because of this. Skin feels smooth and clean after use.
I appreciate that the directions have a dry face and wet face application option. The scrub is gentle but effective!
I like this scrub because it's not too abrasive and my skin feels clean and smooth after i use it.
I liked this product, it's perfect for sensitive skin, it leaves a clean and fresh feeling on the face.
smells really nice and clean and very gentle scrubbiness. a lot if exfoliants have a scratchy feeling but I dont really get that from this

avis.titre: Wanted to love this so badly
avis.texte: I got this a few days ago after finding out anout peach and lily and falling in love with with the discovery kit for glass skin so i decided to try this rice dough smoothing scrub. The smell is amazing and a very nice lemon scent! I loved the feel of it on my face and how great my skin looked. The only downside and the reason I returned it was due to the fact that both times I tried it, I ended up with a really intense headache along my eyebrows where I usually get sinus headaches. I have no idea what could have caused it but it might have been the different extracts in it from the lemon and other fruits and such that were in the scrub. 3/10 overall due to the texture, smell and great looking skin

avis.titre: Perfect exfoliator for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love using this product several times a week. I have dry, mature skin that is sensitive to exfoliators that are too abrasive. The Rice Dough is the perfect texture: like a very moist dough. My skin looks better after using, because it does need exfolation, just not too much or too abrasive. The product has a light scent which dissipates quickly.

avis.titre: Great scrub! Does it replace the rice polisher? Ehh.
avis.texte: Great scrub but prefer the P&L rice polisher. This has an interesting texture and like all P&Lproducts gets the job done thoroughly but gently. I'm part lizard and even with using AHA regularly I still need a physical scrub to clear the road and reset! I'm not sure this replaces the P&L rice polisher scrub for me (I don't like jarred product) but it works great. I just prefer how my skin feels after using rice polisher and it's packaging experience better
It smells nice and it's fluffy but it doesn't do squat. If you have cry baby sensitive skin then this might be for you but for more normal skin it doesn't do much.
This had no scrub feeling and just felt like nothing I returned it. I bought the other powder scrub by them and it's awesome I like a bit of a scrub not to rough but this has nothing.
Have only used it for a few days so far and already notice a difference. Skin looks more radiant, smoother and softer.

This has quickly become one of my favorite skincare products! I have typically avoided physical exfoliation products for my face in the past because I know how damaging they can be, but I trust this brand so much that I decided to give it a try. I'm so glad I did! The texture is so unique and pleasant and it leaves my skin feeling soo smooth. It is surprisingly gentle! I use it 2-3x a week and follow it with my favorite retinol product. Will absolutely be repurchasing!

avis.titre: I think I found my new exfoliator
avis.texte: I love this product. it's super gentle but my face is always so smooth after I use it.

I have been in the market for a facial scrub and I never came across something as luxurious as this. Moderate/gentle exfoliation suspended in what feels like gel/jelly 😍 the perfect texture & safe for everyday use. I love it!
For being a facial scrub, this stuff is really gentle on my sentive skin, while also making my face super soft! Would definitely recommend.

I love how this feels on your skin. I have rosacea plus sensitive skin and usually physical exfoliants I avoid because they are harsh. This is not like that, if feels amazing, hardly like a physical scrub. It leaves my face feeling so soft and it doesn't irritate it. Love Peach and Lily❤️❤️

I absolutely :100: love this product as a gentle face exfoliating scrub! It is so gentle and does its job! I have already bought a backup of it during their sale cause I don't want to be out of it ever! It won't be rough on your skin and should be gentle enough for any skin type. If you haven't tried this, do cause you will be glad you did!
This makes my skin feel so soft, and I love the light and airy texture. It is for sure my favorite physical exfoliation product I have tried. By FAR!
I love the fine texture of this scrub! It is easy to use and makes your face and neck looks smooth.

avis.titre: WOW! BEST FACIAL EXFOLIATION PRODUCT THUS FAR!
avis.texte: Wow! I mean WOW! I would say this is my favorite exforliating facial scrub ever thus far that I've tried in forever! I have had a hard time finding the right one for years and years and I believe I found what I've been looking for FINALLY!! Lol! Seriously, when you're done, your face feels so nice and clean and not feeling like you just scraped the top layer of your face and that you hurt it by all the harsh grits that other products have in theirs. Peach and Lily is one of my favorite skincare brands and I have a tried a good amount of their stuff and this is one of the best ones from their line. I use this 2 times a week and it is so gentle ( but strong enough that it does its job ) that I can still use my Paula's Choice liquid exfoliate too! I don't do that all the time but I wanted to see how gentle it was YES, it is that gentle! OMG! Seriously though, if you're looking for a exfoliating facial scrub that won't mess ur face up, gentle for sensitive skin, and does their job of getting all the dead skin off, then this may be your new product! I don't get paid for saying any of this or work for their company ( wish I did lol ) but if they asked me to, I wouldn't hesitate cause I would so work for a company that I would 1000% agree with their claims!

This smells amazing, texture is soft. I wouldn't call it a "scrub" because the beads in it are so gentle. After a few uses my pores were significantly smaller, my face has never looked better. There has been a big reduction in breakouts. I put it on my face and leave it for a few minutes like a mask while I wash my hair. My favorite Peach and Lily product by far

Haven't used it long enough or consistently to see any extraordinary results. I only use once every other week. A little product goes a long way. I will say the texture is not what I'm used to, but it is gentle on my sensitive skin.

So gentle! This stuff buffs away texture and a long day, leaving you with super soft skin. I only use it every few days, but it's perfect after the gym or the beach. Very gentle and has not irritated my dry-sometimes sensitive skin.

Been looking for a physical exfoliant that is coarse enough to get rid of dry skin but still gentle enough that it won't dry me out and this does that very well - no heavy scents, not scratchy, not drying, and actually gets rid of dry flaky skin. . . and did i say gentle? I take less than a pea size, (a little goes a long way!) and go in tiny circular motions across my face. Love it!

It was a much different texture than I was expecting- but in a good way! It's more light and whipped than you'd guess. I love this product and would highly recommend it and many others from this brand!
I LOVE this product, amazing texture and feels like soft pudding massaging your face. Great scrub
I was surprised by how much I loved this. It's exfoliating without being too drying. The texture is so good and it really smooths my skin without stripping it.
Works well with the rice toner. My pores look smaller and skin is smoother.
When I first started using this scrub, it got rid of the stubborn millia on my cheek in 10ish days (of 1x day use). It's been a staple since (and the millia haven't been back).
:u1F970: amazing! Leaves my skin so soft I can't stop touching it.
I love the soft doughy texture of this exfoliator. I can use it every day to help my skin absorb and benefit from the other skincare treatments and moisturizers.

I absolutely love it! The texture is unlike anything I've tried before – it's incredibly light and airy. The first word that came to mind when I tried it was that it felt 'fluffy.' After just one use, I noticed a visible difference in my skin; it appeared brighter, and I could tell it was gently exfoliating, removing dead skin cells. It also smells so good, which makes the experience even more enjoyable. The jar is made of glass, which adds a nice touch, and I love the minimalist design with a pop of color. I'm already planning to repurpose the jar once I'm done! I'll definitely be repurchasing this and recommending it. I've also introduced it to my 12-year-old son as part of his skincare routine. He's at an age where he's starting to feel self-conscious about pimples and skin imperfections, so I'm teaching him the importance of good skincare and keeping his face clean.
i am probably the most sensitive person ever, but this amazed me. Didnt cause any irritation or even redness. SUPER gentle & really interesting texture. you HAVE to try it.
Best product i have ever used. I plan to make this a permanent part of my skincare routine.

I have sensitive skin but I like a good exfoliator a few times a week to help my dry patches and skin texture. I love Peach & Lily products and this does not dissapoint! The texture is not like anything else I've tried. Its soft and almost gel like, but you can feel the exfoliation in it too. My skin feels so smooth after. It works wonders! I use this 2-3x a week at night or midday after a workout. For a gentle daily exfoliator I use Peach & Lily's glass skin polish which I also HIGHLY recommend!

I impulse bought this and really wanted to not like it since it's a little expensive, but i absolutely love this product. I have sensitive dry skin and this is very gentle and doesn't leave my face dried out. I will definitely repurchase this!

The texture was a little different than i was expecting but i love how gentle it is on my face. It leaves my skin so soft! I wish this came in a squeeze bottle as i do not like sticking my fingers into the container but over all a great product!
I absolutely love this it doesn't dry out your face and leaves it very smooth. It's gentle but yet helps remove impurities , I personally use it twice a week and it perfect.

I am leery of facial scrubs because I have very sensitive, redness-prone skin. This product is nothing like any other exfoliating, scrub-type product on the market. It has a soft, doughy text and although you can feel the scrubbing particles, it us not abrasive at all. After using it, my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. A little also goes a very long way-- my current pot is lasting forever. A great addition to Peach and Lily's cleanser line.
It was good at first! Now it is just a weird consistency not sure what changed?
A little goes a long way- I use this every couple of weeks and my skin loves the results. My skin feels smooth, clean and exfoliated. I love pairing this with the rice toner!
This is perfect for me. Light citrus fragance. Very luxurious feel!

I used this for the 1st time tonight and I honestly say that it is the best facial scrub! It is gentle and does a great job on the face! It doesn't fee gritty like the other ones I've tried and when I did my facial regimen, my face felt absolutely soft and smooth! My nose felt a little bumpy and after I used this, the bumpy were completely gone! I wish I got more cause this jar won't last long lol! If you are considering this, then don't think about it anymore and just get it. You won't regret and you will end up liking it hopefully as much as I do!
Completely cleared up my dry flaky skin and leaves my skin so soft and smooth. I love the scent and a little goes a long way. Gorgeous packaging as well!

avis.titre: A bit pricey but worth it!
avis.texte: Tried this on my sensitive acne prone skin and it made it very smooth without it being to harsh or tearing at my skin.
I love the natural ingredients and how my face feels afterwards.

I love this scrub because it does a fabulous job. I placed it in the shower for convenience and one day got the idea of using it on my legs which get dry and flaky in the winter no matter how much lotion I use. It works beautifully! Now I can lotion after my shower and have smooth, lovely legs until the next time. Also, my husband told me he started using it on his head (he is bald) and it does a better job than any of his usual products. But there's a bonus! This product smells wonderful - even my husband commented about it. It's like a trip to a spa.
It rubs on so smoothly, it smells so clean and leaves my skin feeling fresh
Made my skin so soft. Still using and testing it out. Its been good so far.

avis.titre: This Scrub Is Smoothing and Softening
avis.texte: The Rice Dough Smoothing Facial Scrub is my new go-to for my combination skin. It is very gentle, has a pillow like feel and little goes a long way. I feel comfortable using a little bit every day, especially on my T-zone.
This is a good product. I wanted to try this new product to see if it works for my dry skin.
I love the advertisement about this but it doesn't remove those things in my face afterwards I still need to find a face scrub to feel my pores.

avis.titre: Texture is Nothing I've Felt Before
avis.texte: The description of this product is spot on. I thought it was going to be a lot rougher than it is due to the rice, but the doughy texture is smooth and bouncy. It's cloudy and almost gummy. Hard to explain but feels great when you rub the product in between your fingers. The aftermath feeling of your skin after the product is washed off takes some getting used to. It feels like it cleans well but at the same time, almost feels like a film of sorts lay atop the skin. Not sure how I feel about this part yet but will continue to use to see what benefits it has to offer.
I love the texture of this scrub. It's light and fluffy. A little bit goes a long way. It feels luxurious on my skin. After I wash it off, my pores feel so clean.
The texture is not like anything I've used before and my skin literally loves it. I can see the almost immediate glow after using this stuff along with the toner.
This product leaves my skin smooth and glowing. I love all my Peach and Lily products.

I never write reviews, but I had to for this! I have very, very sensitive cheeks and any sort of scrub or exfoliator (including "sensitive skin" ones) usually leaves my face feeling raw/burnt. When this product was released, I was so excited to try it since the scrubbing effect was from the rice dough texture and it just seemed to be much gentler. I was right to be excited! This scrub was incredibly gentle when I massaged this into my face. Out of abundance of caution, I used it with water, but I am confident I can use it dry too and still not have any issues. My face feels very soft after using it and I had zero adverse reaction. The scrub actually scrubs without tearing the skin and doesn't leave me having to slather my face in the repair cream to soothe. A little bit goes a long way, the container is luxurious and sturdy like Peach & Lily products tend to be, and the texture of the scrub is just lovely. Definitely recommending this one to anyone, especially those who has very sensitive skin like me!

Like all the other products that I've been using from peach and Lily I love it. I love love love it Vietnamese lady at the nail salon, kept looking at me and I looked back at her and she said your skin looks so nice and I was like out of all the products that I have tried before in the past and trust me there have been many. I have spent Buku money on facial products. I have never gotten a compliment on my face. I'm 69 years old and I could not be happier with the results of peach and Lily facial products.

First I thought this scrub was going to be super abrasive but it is not! I is more of a soft scrub that doesn't irritate the skin when used. Left my skin smooth and soft. Would defintely purchase again.
Very nice! Makes my skin feel so soft and smooth! It exfoliates very well, and so pleased with the results. The smell is invigorating and always look forward to using this. Highly recommend!!!
Perfect for exfoliating before applying makeup. Allows for the makeup to apply super smooth.
The texture of this is not what I was expecting, but it definitely is exactly what I'm looking for in an exfoliator. Not too rough, but still gives me a smooth finish without giving me red skin.

This thick and creamy light exfoliator feels fantastic on the skin. It is the perfect step after double cleansing to help reduce pore size and see results. The only flaw is that you have to twist open the lid and dip already fingers in - making it hard to not drip and leave water inside jar. Nonetheless, it's a fantastic daily exfoliator for my 55 yr old face!!
This is a gentle scrub, helps keep. pores clear. It has a gentle smell, perfect for a pick me up to my skin when it's looks dull.

avis.titre: Rice Dough Smoothing Facial Scrub Review
avis.texte: It has a slight sweet natural fragrance, but it's wonderful. It doesn't scratch my skin like other physical exfoliators have. My skin is always softer after using it, and it keeps my pores clean and small. I use it instead of the resurfacing mask because I don't like the tingling, and it works just great!
